question: She / He gave up dancing and studied the sitar under the noted musician Ustad Allauddin Khan. She / He was also the music director of All-India Radio from 1948 until 1956. Who among the following was that person?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ravi Shankar__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ravi Shankar **(Indian musician, player of the sitar, composer)**​​**

 
 
• ​Ravi Shankar **gave up dancing at the age of 18.**
 
• For the next seven years,** he studied the sitar under the noted musician Ustad Allauddin Khan.**
 
• He served as **music director of All-India Radio from 1948 until 1956.**
 
• He **won Grammy Awards** for the albums "West Meets East (1966)", "The Concert for Bangladesh (1971)", and "Full Circle (2001)".
 
• Two months after his death, **Shankar won a fourth Grammy Award,** for an intimate **collection of ragas titled "The Living Room Sessions Part 1".**
 
• He was the** founder of the National Orchestra of India.​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Mamata Shankar**

 
 
• ​Mamata Shankar is an** Indian actress and dancer.**
 
• She is** known for her work in Bengali cinema.**
 
 
 
• **Ananda Shankar​**
 
 
• ​Ananda Shankar was an** Indian musician, singer, and composer.**
 
• Best **known for fusing Western and Eastern musical styles.**
 
 
 
• **Uday Shankar​**
 
 
• ​Uday Shankar was an** Indian dancer and choreographer.**
 
• **Known for creating a fusion style of dance, **adapting European theatrical techniques to Indian classical dance.
 
• In **1962,** he was awarded the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship for lifetime achievement.**
 
• In **1971**, the Govt. of India, awarded him its second-highest civilian award the **Padma Vibhushan.**
